# If a parameter is retired, its GUID is burned and never reused.

# USERMODIFIABLE was not specified per-parameter in the blueprint (only Mark=1
# and Created_By_NOSA=0 were given as examples) — the rest is a disclosed F1
# judgement call, applied consistently:
#   0 (plugin-owned, do not hand-edit): anything COMPUTED by a generator/
#     classifier/marking pass and re-derived on every run (all of Shape,
#     most of Status, most of Fabrication, Detail_Section_Id), plus internal
#     lookups/caches (Host_Id, Position_In_Host, Export_Id, BVBS_Line).
#   1 (user-editable): free-text organisational fields (Mark*, Layer, Group,
#     Assembly), fields a user genuinely sets by hand (Steel_Grade, Coupler_*,
#     EndTreatment_*, Tag_Offset_*, Show_In_Schedule), and Revision/
#     Issue_Status (normal editable metadata) — plus Finalized, which MUST be
#     user-modifiable: it's the "do not regenerate this bar" flag the user
#     sets to protect a bar from a future batch run.
